text: Nvidia plans to invest in four German startups: Agile Robots, Avelios Medical, Mirelo and Reflex Aerospace, CNBC reports. Amounts weren't disclosed. It's part of Nvidia's nearly $10 billion commitment to European AI, announced at a Berlin summit Monday.
